lead: Pakistan's western flank dominates the day: a suicide attack in D.I. Khan, a formal protest to Kabul over airspace, and an official warning that ties with Afghanistan are past the point of no return. At home, IMF talks on the next $1.2bn tranche began as oil above $105 a barrel weighed on markets, and Islamabad has yet to decide whether to cut flight and banking links with Iran under US sanctions.

stories.headline: Pakistan–Afghanistan reset looks unlikely, officials signal
stories.summary: An official told the Express Tribune relations had passed the point of no return. Separately, Pakistan used a UN crime congress in Abu Dhabi to warn of a possible revival of Afghan opium cultivation and growing synthetic drug production.

stories.headline: No decision yet on cutting Iran links under US sanctions
stories.summary: A Pakistani aviation official said the government has not decided whether to suspend flights or banking channels with Iran in light of US sanctions, leaving Islamabad balancing US pressure against ties with its neighbour.

stories.headline: Pakistan opens first SCO meeting of its chairmanship year
stories.summary: National coordinators of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation are meeting in Islamabad from 28 to 30 September to set the work programme for Pakistan's year leading the bloc's top decision-making body.

stories.headline: Pakistani pilots train in China for first crewed spaceflight
stories.summary: Two pilots are preparing for a mission to China's space station, a showcase of the space dimension of the China–Pakistan relationship.

stories.headline: Malaysia and Pakistan agree to expand rice and halal trade
stories.summary: The two countries will cooperate on rice exports, halal certification and food security.

stories.headline: At least 12 killed in suicide attack on D.I. Khan checkpost
stories.summary: The attack on an anti-smuggling checkpoint in Darazanda on Saturday killed women and children among others; Geo puts the toll at 13. Pakistan says an Afghan national was involved, BBC Urdu reports.

stories.headline: Three traffic police killed in Tank ambush
stories.summary: Gunmen fired on a police van in Wazirabad Bazaar, also injuring two passers-by — the latest in a run of attacks in southern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

stories.headline: Centre and KP government trade blame over militancy
stories.summary: Federal ministers accused the PTI-led provincial government of failing to act against militants; Chief Minister Sohail Afridi replied that the centre's own policy had failed for two decades and asked for a say in counter-terror strategy.

stories.headline: ISPR says over 70 militants killed in Balochistan
stories.summary: The military said the four days of operations targeted groups it accuses India of backing; the figures could not be independently verified.

stories.headline: Iran says no talks with US are planned
stories.summary: Iranian state media denied new negotiations after President Trump said he expected talks this week; the stalemate over the Strait of Hormuz is keeping oil prices high.

stories.headline: New Hangor-class submarine completes first live missile firing
stories.summary: The navy's newly inducted, Chinese-designed submarine fired anti-ship missiles in the North Arabian Sea, according to ISPR.

stories.headline: IMF review talks for next $1.2bn tranche begin
stories.summary: Formal negotiations with the visiting IMF mission on the fourth review of Pakistan's $7bn loan programme started in Islamabad.

stories.headline: 25% water shortfall forecast for Rabi season
stories.summary: Reservoir carry-over has fallen to its lowest since 2021, adding pressure on a wheat crop already short last season.

stories.headline: Pakistan draws offers in 185,000-tonne wheat import tender
stories.summary: The lowest offer was about $339 a tonne, European traders said.

stories.headline: No state money or guarantees for privatised PIA's aircraft
stories.summary: A finance ministry adviser said the government will neither buy planes for the airline nor guarantee loans for them.

stories.headline: PSX falls over 400 points as Brent tops $105
stories.summary: Early gains reversed as oil jumped on the US–Iran stalemate. The rupee edged up to 277.15 to the dollar, while gold fell by Rs12,800 per tola.

stories.headline: Pakistan first to join Hong Kong's ValidAP trade platform
stories.summary: Pakistan Single Window has connected to the blockchain-based trade document verification system, which aims to speed up and secure cross-border trade.

stories.headline: Pakistan protests to Kabul over airspace violation
stories.summary: The Foreign Office issued a demarche to the Afghan embassy over what it called a violation of Pakistani airspace last week, after rejecting Taliban claims linking Pakistan to violence in Nuristan.

stories.headline: GPS spoofing blamed as Sialkot flight 'appeared' in Indian-administered Kashmir
stories.summary: Flight trackers showed a Qatar Airways flight circling across the border; Sialkot airport said it landed normally, and Geo's analysis points to GPS spoofing in the border region.

stories.headline: PML-N holds Bahawalpur's NA-168 seat
stories.summary: Malik Munir Iqbal Channar won the by-election with 79,306 votes to 42,623 for independent Wali Dad Cheema.

stories.headline: PTI offers talks as governor's rule in KP is debated
stories.summary: The party renewed its dialogue offer ahead of its 4 October march, while dismissing threats of governor's rule in the province.

stories.headline: Heavy rain disrupts Islamabad and Rawalpindi
stories.summary: Flights from Jeddah and Paris were diverted and civic bodies were put on alert.
